غَبِيبٌ : see غَابٌّ. ＝
-A2- Also A small and narrow water-course, from the hard and elevated part of a mountain, or of a tract of land: or in plain. or level, land: (TA:) and a watercourse that is not deep, and in which are [trees of the species called] طَلْح: pl. [of pauc.] أَغِبَّةٌ and [of mult.] غُبَّانٌ. (JK.) ＝
-A3- [And An affair or a business (“ res, negotium ”). (Freytag, from the Deewán of Jereer.)]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
